description: Header file defining the HdmiCec class, which manages HDMI CEC functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin architecture, including event handling, settings management, and JSONRPC interface methods.

classes.name: HdmiCec
classes.description: A plugin class for HDMI CEC management, handling JSONRPC methods, event callbacks, and device settings within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: setEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to enable or disable CEC functionality based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: getEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve current CEC enable status.

methods.name: getCECAddressesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to get CEC device addresses.

methods.name: sendMessageWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to send a CEC message.

methods.name: cecMgrEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for CEC manager events.

methods.name: dsHdmiEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for HDMI hotplug events.

methods.name: cecStatusUpdated
methods.description: Updates internal status based on CEC events.

methods.name: FromBase64String
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into a byte array.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a notification with CEC frame data.
